research:
Based on Nancy Pelosi’s 2025 annual report, supplemented by PTRs filed through **August 21, 2026**, these are the disclosed stock and call-option holdings I could identify. **Stock value ranges below are generally from the annual report’s December 31, 2025 valuation—not current market values.** Later purchases and exercises are shown using their reported transaction ranges; the filings do not provide a complete updated valuation of every remaining stock holding.

### Stocks disclosed as held
- Alphabet (GOOGL): **$5,000,001–$25,000,000**
- Amazon (AMZN): **$5,000,001–$25,000,000**
- American Express (AXP): **$1,000,001–$5,000,000**
- Apple (AAPL): **$5,000,001–$25,000,000**
- AT&T (T): **$100,001–$250,000**
- Block (SQ): **$250,001–$500,000**
- Broadcom (AVGO): **$5,000,001–$25,000,000**
- Clean Energy Fuels (CLNE): **$1,001–$15,000**
- Comcast (CMCSA): **$500,001–$1,000,000**
- CrowdStrike (CRWD): **$1,000,001–$5,000,000**
- Dropbox (DBX): **$250,001–$500,000**
- Interactive Brokers (IBKR): **$500,001–$1,000,000**
- Microsoft (MSFT): **$5,000,001–$25,000,000**
- Morningstar (MORN): **$100,001–$250,000**
- Netflix (NFLX): **$1,000,001–$5,000,000**
- NVIDIA (NVDA): **$5,000,001–$25,000,000**
- Palo Alto Networks (PANW): **$1,000,001–$5,000,000**
- Roblox (RBLX): **$250,001–$500,000**
- Salesforce (CRM): **$5,000,001–$25,000,000**
- Visa (V): **$5,000,001–$25,000,000**
- Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD): **$50,001–$100,000**
- Bloom Energy (BE): purchases reported in July 2026 of 10,000 shares (**$1,000,001–$5,000,000**) and 5,000 shares (**$500,001–$1,000,000**)
- Intel (INTC): 10,000 shares purchased in July 2026 (**$500,001–$1,000,000**)
- The January 2026 PTRs also report call-option exercises into shares of **GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, TEM, and VST**. Those reports give transaction-value ranges, not updated total holdings valuations.

### Call options disclosed as unexpired
- **GOOGL:** 20 calls, $150 strike, exp. **Jan. 15, 2027** — **$250,001–$500,000**
- **AMZN:** 20 calls, $120 strike, exp. **Jan. 15, 2027** — **$100,001–$250,000**
- **AAPL:** 20 calls, $100 strike, exp. **Jan. 15, 2027** — **$250,001–$500,000**
- **NVDA:** 20 calls, $100 strike, exp. **Jan. 15, 2027** — **$100,001–$250,000**
- **INTC:** 200 calls, $50 strike, exp. **Mar. 19, 2027** — **$1,000,001–$5,000,000**; plus 50 calls, $50 strike, exp. **June 17, 2027** — **$250,001–$500,000**
- **UBER:** 200 calls, $50 strike, exp. **Mar. 19, 2027** — **$500,001–$1,000,000**
- **BE:** 100 calls, $100 strike, exp. **June 17, 2027** — **$1,000,001–$5,000,000**; plus 100 calls with the same strike and expiration — **$500,001–$1,000,000**

I excluded options reported as exercised or expired by the time of the latest filings, along with funds, bonds, real estate, and private-company interests. These are disclosure-based holdings, not a real-time account statement; partial sales and donations mean the annual-report stock ranges may not reflect the amounts still held.

Sources: House Clerk 2025 annual report, filed **May 15, 2026** (https://disclosures-clerk.house.gov/public_disc/financial-pdfs/2025/10075701.pdf), and PTRs filed **January 23, June 23, and August 21, 2026** (House Clerk PTR PDFs for filing IDs 20033725, 20034836, and 20035143).

RESULT: No trade was made; I compiled the disclosed holdings from the latest annual report and subsequent reports through August 21, 2026.
